map.source: Existing native HUD corner-map isolation and GPU texture copy; no world exploration reconstruction or CPU pixel readback

map.image: 512x512 OpenXR float swapchain, aspect-preserving fit, bilinear filtering, SDR color conversion, opaque dark backing and border
map.placement: 24 cm square, doubled from 12 cm at the owner's request; center 19 cm above the wrist life/mana/XP panel, retaining a 1 cm gap; same image submitted to both eyes
map.lifetime: New native capture required each XR pair; no reuse of the previous area's image
map.visibility: Raised tracked left wrist with fresh session snapshot, no wheel or native menu
map.native_panel: UI-thread lease temporarily opens AutoMap and restores an initially closed map; preserves initially open maps, releases for menus/session changes/expired XR updates
